context: Apple's June 2026 HLS guidance says a whole AVPlayerItem audio mix can be tapped using the new mix track ID, except FairPlay content. The Xcode 27 header says whole-mix taps should use MTAudioProcessingTapCreateWithPreferredFormat and the actual LPCM details still need inspection in prepare.
Target deployment is iOS 27.0, Swift language mode 6.0. The code is not yet compiled with Xcode 27 in our environment.
The onPrepared closure currently schedules UI state via Task { @MainActor in ... } in its caller.
